description: This file defines extension methods for managing resource factory registries within Orleans grain contexts, including registration and retrieval of resource factories.

classes.name: ResourceFactoryRegistry<T>
classes.description: A dictionary mapping resource names to factory functions, used to manage resource creation within grain contexts.

methods.name: RegisterResourceFactory
methods.description: Registers a resource factory with a given name in the grain context's resource registry.

methods.name: GetResourceFactoryRegistry
methods.description: Retrieves the resource factory registry from the grain context, optionally creating it if it does not exist.
